references.text: Theological contrast: Fear that the remnant will disappear (Judg 21) versus confession that a remnant is preserved despite guilt (Ezra 9).
Direct narrative connection: The question of losing a tribe (v.3) and the solution to preserve it (v.17).
Direct narrative connection: The question of the wicked act (Judg 20) and the question of its consequence for the tribe (Judg 21).
